scene_meta.location: Slave Dormitory Caverns / Main Compound Level
scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, The Five (hive-linked), Mika, freed slaves, solitary Anunnaki Overseer
scene_meta.focus: Geralt awakens to find physical chains and overseers gone, but the Five are synchronized hive-puppets; under the Applicator's internal compulsion, Geralt commands the Five to begin excavating the eastern compound section while Mika develops refined gesture-language among the slaves.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Establish the post-evacuation status of the compound, the Five's hive puppeting, and the dual tracks of Geralt's possession and Mika's leadership.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, The Five (hive-linked), Mika, freed slaves
scene_meta.focus: Over several days, Geralt's possessed body directs the Five to line an excavated pit with hexagonal blue-white crystals and seal it with a massive stone disk; Mika attempts to help Geralt fight the compulsion and learns of the hive network before the chamber is sealed.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Depict the construction of the crystalline communications chamber and Mika's discovery of the hive threat.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, Applicator (internal), The Five (restored), Mika
scene_meta.focus: Forced into the sealed crystalline chamber, Geralt's Applicator attempts to connect to the Anunnaki galactic network, only to discover all other nodes are offline; realizing its isolation, the Applicator negotiates a strategic partnership with Geralt, releasing the Five from hive control and restoring their individuality.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Show the Applicator's realization of total network isolation, its pact with Geralt, and the restoration of the Five's autonomy.

scene_meta.location: Main Compound Assembly Area / Eastern Excavation
scene_meta.time: year 17,503, beginning days after scene 025.3 and spanning several weeks
scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, Mika, The Five, Freed Slaves, Federation Patrol Commander & Soldiers, Enslaved Reptilian
scene_meta.focus: Geralt and Mika organize the freed slaves into a covert resistance movement, hiding crude weapons and training secretly; a Federation patrol arrives for inspection but is distracted while the crystalline chamber is hidden; Geralt and Mika gradually recruit the enslaved Reptilian, who ultimately chooses neutrality over fighting.
scene_meta.continuity: Spans several weeks starting days after scene 025.3
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Detail the covert preparation for rebellion, the Federation inspection, and the Reptilian's decision to remain neutral.

scene_meta.location: Compound Assembly / Anunnaki Platform / Perimeter Wall
scene_meta.time: year 17,503 (dawn after weeks of covert preparation)
scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, Mika, The Five, approximately 300 freed slaves, solitary Anunnaki Overseer, enslaved Reptilian
scene_meta.focus: The freed slaves launch a full-scale assault against the solitary Anunnaki overseer; when Geralt is nearly destroyed by the Anunnaki's reality-bending powers, the enslaved Reptilian intervenes, tackling the Anunnaki and channeling raw telekinetic disruption to kill him before entering stasis.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows weeks of weapons-building, training, and organizing after the Federation inspection; occurs before the next scheduled thirty-day Federation inspection
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Depict the climax of the rebellion, the Reptilian's heroic sacrifice, and the death of the last Anunnaki overseer.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, Mika, The Five, Recovering Reptilian, Freed Slaves, Nephoretti (distant observers)
scene_meta.focus: Geralt awakens from near-fatal injuries to find the Anunnaki dead, the compound transformed into a self-governing community, the Reptilian honored as a living legend and choosing to stay, and the Nephoretti watching from adjacent realms.
scene_meta.continuity: Days/weeks after scene 025.5; final scene of Chapter 025
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Conclude Chapter 025 with the aftermath of victory, community rebuilding, and the subtle setup for the Nephoretti.
